name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 3 No 33

clue.text: One may take walk between rivers
As thinking a learner comes to subsequently?
Resistance? Such isn’t welcomed by nobleman
City girl without help
Go through water mostly with one? Mostly not!
Does a transplant job on the ’ead and behaves affectedly
Ray raves drunkenly around pub, having returned for celebration
Free but lacking the wherewithal for a picnic?
Boat with an unpleasant look almost
Wondering at silly maid being given token of betrothal
Bunker caretaker
One expressing anger with a v. difficult clue?
Town man (bluff type?) I copy
Don’t let an elemental poison get into fruit
Washing a bin out carelessly, leaving a bit of litter in
Spoil cat climbing up on me
Famished? Be delirious before common sense is evident
Girl the Archdeacon chucked up is in a state
Zeus’s agent of punishment could issue a pardon
Devon country mansion from which one may obtain good clarets
Being injured, I’ve made arrangements to abstain in Parliament
Bridle — relax it, did you say?
Terribly annoyed? This should have soothing effect
Chap with hose — nothing for one to be a supervisor
Austria by means of railway? One has restricted flights
Bit of skin somehow flawed but soft rather than the opposite
